mira (Product): Quick announcement — we are launching a new Remote Support Access (RSA) policy for Redwood Private deployments starting today. This is an opt-in, auditable pathway for our Support and SRE teams to help customers with on-prem/VPC issues without us having persistent access.

mira (Product): Key points: 1) customer must explicitly enable RSA via the Console or API; 2) access is JIT (time-bound) and uses ephemeral credentials; 3) every session is recorded, telemetry is stored in the customer's designated log sink (or option to ship to Redwood with customer consent); 4) RSA integrates with customer KMS for key attestations.

mira (Product): Schedule: soft launch today for 5 pilot customers, org-wide rollout in 2 weeks. We will only enable for customers who sign the support acknowledgement and complete the RSA checklist.

jonah (EngInfra): Tech note: RSA leverages our existing support tunnel agent but runs it in readonly mode by default. When a JIT session is requested we spin a short-lived container with a constrained role and no write privileges. The agent emits a session ARN you can paste into the runbook for auditing.

jonah (EngInfra): Example enable CLI: 
```
redwood private rsa enable --org <org-id> --duration 2h --require-approval=on
```

sarah (Security): Security signoff summary: Approved with conditions — MFA and org-admin approval required for all JIT requests, mandatory session recording retention of 180 days for SOC2 customers, and an automated alert to the customer's audit log. No fallback to legacy support keys.

sarah (Security): We also added a consent UI flow that clearly explains what we can see and what remains customer-only. If a customer declines telemetry export, support sessions still run but recordings remain in the customer's storage endpoint.

tony (Sales): Important for accounts — message to customers: "No persistent access. You opt in. You control logs & retention." Can product ops share a one-page customer-facing FAQ I can send to pilots? Also want a short blurb for renewal decks.

mira (Product): Yep — FAQ and support checklist uploaded to the Private docs space. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/private/rsa-faq (internal). Please use that for all customer comms.

infra-bot: deploy-notification: RSA ui flag toggled on in staging at 2026-03-23T10:12:43Z, will gated-rollout to prod tomorrow morning.

jonah (EngInfra): Ops notes for oncall: if a session fails to establish, check agent certificates and the customer's egress rules (common issue for air-gapped installs). We added a new diagnostic: `rsa diag` that bundles logs for quicker triage.

mira (Product): Training: two 30-minute walk-throughs scheduled (internal): Wed 16:00 UTC and Thu 00:00 UTC. I posted calendar invites to the SRE, Support, Sales AE, and Solutions Eng groups. If you're on-call for pilots, attend one.

tony (Sales): ACK — I’ll prep customer emails for pilot cohort and share with Legal.

sarah (Security): FYI — compliance team will run a mini-audit with pilot customers to validate retention controls. Expect a checklist from me by EOD.

mira (Product): Thanks team. Primary contacts: mira (Product) for rollout questions, jonah (EngInfra) for tech/diagnostics, sarah (Security) for compliance. We'll post a short incident-like runbook in the incidents channel if we see any early P0s.

mira (Product): TL;DR: Remote Support Access = opt-in, JIT, auditable, integrates with KMS and customer's logs. Pilots start now, rollout in ~2 weeks. Please read the FAQ and join one training session. :rocket:
